Class Logger

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.common.Logger
public class Logger extends Object
Utility class for logging messages with color-coded output and timestamp formatting.

Supports logging at different severity levels: INFO, DEBUG, WARNING, and ERROR. Can be configured to enable or disable debug messages dynamically.
